mockSemantics.commentSemantics: common/payment.js header claims "不再静默 fallback 到 mock 模式" (no silent mock fallback)
mockSemantics.actualRuntimeSemantics: getConfig() sets isMock = !mchid; jsapiOrder returns success:true + _mock:true when isMock; queryOrder returns tradeState=SUCCESS + MOCK_TXN_ when isMock
mockSemantics.mockSuccessReturnedBy: common/payment.js jsapiOrder (success:true, _mock:true) AND queryOrder (success:true, tradeState:SUCCESS, MOCK_TXN_)
mockSemantics.mockSuccessConsumedBy: verifyPayment/index.js: queryOrder().tradeState === SUCCESS -> mark order paid + grantEntitlements
mockSemantics.orderMarkedPaidOnMock: NO (post-R1: server-side guard rejects before paid mutation)
mockSemantics.entitlementGrantedOnMock: NO (post-R1: server-side guard rejects before grantEntitlements)

r1Guard.serverDerivedMockState: MOCK_TXN_ prefix written by server-side common/payment.js mock queryOrder branch (not client-controlled)
r1Guard._mockPropagation: NOT_PROPAGATED_INTO_QUERYORDER_RESULT (present only in jsapiOrder paymentParams); defensive _mock===true check retained
r1Guard.rejectionSemantics: return fail(CODES.PAYMENT_ERROR=10009, '模拟支付结果不可作为真实支付') — non-success code, no uncontrolled throw
r1Guard.guardPlacement: BEFORE payment_logs write, BEFORE paid mutation, BEFORE grantEntitlements

amountAuthority.clientSubmittedAmount: PRESENT (clientPrice field, optional, VALIDATED not authoritative)
amountAuthority.serverRecomputedAmount: PRESENT (createOrder: totalAmount = product.price from products DB)
amountAuthority.paymentProviderAmount: PRESENT (jsapiOrder body amount.total = totalAmount from server)
amountAuthority.callbackVerifiedAmount: PRESENT (payCallback: amount.total !== order.totalAmount -> log + _ok, no entitlement)

P1_MISSING_MCHID.note: mock fallback confirmed: isMock=true, success:true, _mock:true, queryOrder SUCCESS

P2_MALFORMED_AMOUNT.note: requires products DB + createOrder cloud fn

P4_DUPLICATE_ORDER_CALLBACK.note: checkDuplicateOrder + transactionId idempotency present in source

P5_MISSING_SIGNATURE.note: payCallback requires 4 wechatpay headers; missing -> 400 MISSING_HEADERS (source)

P6_INVALID_SIGNATURE.note: RSA-SHA256 verify present; requires platform cert env

P9_TIMEOUT.note: requires network; axios timeout 15000/10000 present in source

P10_DUPLICATE_ENTITLEMENT.note: transactionId idempotency present; membership renewal extends

amountUnit: FEN (分) — totalAmount in fen; DAILY_AI_BUDGET_FEN=50000 分=¥500
